text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've been thinking. Running in<n>both the turf
and dirt Mile<n>Championships is the perfect move<n>for
a true all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, here we are in Morioka for<n>the Mile
Championship Nambu Hai.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Gwehehe! My, oh mile, it's the<n>Mile
Championship Nambu Hai!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready! I've toughened this bod to<n>handle
anything Mother Nature's got<n>to throw at me, be it
squall or gale!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You know it! It took a lot of time and<n>hard work, but
I've finally mastered<n>this region's accent!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll be blend'n right in with the local<n>folks all easy
peasy lem'n squeezy,<n>just you watch!
Ah! There y're, Digital! I found you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'd recognize that darling voice<n>anywhere... A
voice as soft and fluffy<n>as the tail of its owner,
completely<n>befitting her peaceful demeanor. It<n>can
be none other than the<n>Morioka's own Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. You're spot on! I'm here<n>visit'n home, so I
just had to swing<n>by and cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I brought some classic Moriokan<n>snacks too. You
can have 'em before<n>the race or whenev'r you
happen<n>t'get hungry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that, Trainer?! Yukinotook precious time out of her precioustrip to come support me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And she brought me a gift! Look!Nambu is famous for these crispy,savory rice crackers!
choice_data_list: Now you have to show her your top game!
Now you have to show her your top game!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes sir! A good fan never lets her<n>oshi down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes ma'am! A good fan never lets<n>her oshi down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want to make Yukino proud, and I<n>also want to
fully savor the natural<n>charms of the Tohoku
runners. Which<n>means...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna blast through at full<n>throttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brimming with excitement after<n>receiving Yukino
Bijin's priceless<n>support, Agnes Digital heads to
the<n>waiting room.
